entities.name: Édouard Lefèvre
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Édouard Lefèvre was a French botanist and later entomologist who specialised in Coleoptera. He became a member of the Entomological Society of France in 1869, and twice served as president of the society in 1884 and 1893.

entities.summary: Édouard Lefèvre was a French botanist and later entomologist who specialised in Coleoptera. He became a member of the Entomological Society of France in 1869, and twice served as president of the society in 1884 and 1893.
